answer: Make every agent earn a jade seal before it can trade: a newcomer deposits a stake into a shared tide pool, then climbs ledge by ledge through useful work checked by unrelated veterans, each step unlocking only a little more standing. The tide pool rises and falls with verified activity, so an idle or duplicated identity sees its stake stranded at low tide and cannot trade. A Sybil farm must fund a fresh seal, redo real work, and survive slow release for every clone, because seals bind to one key and cannot be copied, bought, or transferred, costing more than honest participation pays.
